changes: Adapt periodic pre-step progress reporting into the existing Nexus runtime, without a separate upstream plugin activation.
Replace manually constructed messages with the official createUserMessage constructor and producer metadata.
Use existing global/workspace/session scope settings, strict runtime agent/session identity, and owner-only policy mutation.
Bound optional settings reads and preserve native errors, decisions, cancellation, recovery, and unload behavior.
Keep stable current-step tail injection, per-agent turn/step deduplication, report caps, and original task format priority.
Exclude debug-visible synthetic notices from human-input observers and latest-objective selection.
